blocks.text: ILIGAN CITY — Church-based youth groups and religious leaders here joined the weeklong Mindanao Week of Peace (MWOP), which kicked off on Thursday, using information campaigns and interfaith activities to promote understanding and challenge perceptions of Mindanao as a conflict-stricken region. Ruel Rosario, committee in-charge of the Justice, Peace and Development Committee of the Catholic Center Campus Ministry (CCCM) of the Diocese of Iligan, said the group participated in the celebrations despite limited manpower and resources. Most members are graduating college students who are currently occupied with thesis writing and other graduation requirements, Rosario said. READ: Mindanao Week of Peace 2026 […]...
